biography: Matti made two appearances in the Hector Trophée, carving out a specific, albeit brief, history within this prestigious pairs competition. His entries allowed him to engage with the unique demands of the tournament format.

Across these two demanding engagements, Matti applied himself with diligent effort. However, the ultimate accolades of the Hector Trophée for his partnership, and the prestigious Victor Trophy for individual prowess, remained beyond his grasp.

With the Hector Trophée 2026 on the horizon, Matti's participation in Hector events is now considered to have concluded. While his name will not appear on this year's roster, his brief yet determined presence forms a distinct part of the tournament's expanding historical record.
